description:
Given a CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24), return network, broadcast, netmask, first/last host, and host count.

Returns: JSON with network, broadcast, first/last host, host count, and mask for the CIDR.
Example input: {"cidr":"192.168.1.0/24"}
On error, includes hint: `cidr` must be IPv4 in `A.B.C.D/prefix` form, prefix 0-32.
name: subnet_calculator
title: Subnet calculator (IPv4)
